gloss: to get done in time; to make do with

definitions.gloss: to get (something) ready in time; to make it in time
definitions.explanation: To arrange things so that a deadline or departure time is met. The transitive counterpart of {間|ま}に{合|あ}う: the subject actively makes the timing work.

definitions.gloss: to make do with; to get by using (something) temporarily
definitions.explanation: To use whatever is at hand as a stopgap because the proper thing is unavailable. Usually marked with で: ありもので{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる (make do with what we have).

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: I'll get it done in time for the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{働|はたら}いて→働く：00503_hataraku⟧⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: We worked until morning and got the delivery in on time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{開店|かいてん}→開店：14569_kaiten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦{早|はや}めた→早める：04587_hayameru⟧。
examples.english: To make it in time for the opening day, we moved the construction up by two weeks.

examples.japanese: ありもの⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせよう。
examples.english: Let's make do with what we have.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: Today I got by with a convenience store bento.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧な⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせておいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Until the official documents arrive, please make do with photocopies.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. It is the causative-style partner of the intransitive ⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧ (I make the train) versus ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる (I get things ready in time for the departure).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる: to meet a deadline
- ⟦{納期|のうき}→納期：07772_nouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる: to meet a delivery date
- ありもの⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせる: to make do with what is on hand
- {間|ま}に{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: makeshift, stopgap (used as a modifier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{済|す}ませる→済ませる：02121_sumaseru⟧: to finish off, to settle — about completing something, without the timing or stopgap nuance
- ⟦{代用|だいよう}→代用：16439_daiyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to substitute — a neutral, more formal word for sense 2
